description: Configure pre-commit hooks for a Python project to enforce code quality standards. The workspace is at /home/ga/workspace/myapp/ which is a git repository with Python code. Your task: (1) Install the 'pre-commit' package using pip: 'pip install pre-commit' or 'pip3 install pre-commit'. (2) Create a file named '.pre-commit-config.yaml' in the repository root (/home/ga/workspace/myapp/.pre-commit-config.yaml) with configuration for these four hooks: 'black' (Python formatter), 'flake8' (Python linter), 'detect-secrets' (secret detection), and 'check-added-large-files' (prevent large files >5MB). You can find hook configurations at https://pre-commit.com or use repositories like 'https://github.com/psf/black' for black, 'https://github.com/pycqa/flake8' for flake8, 'https://github.com/Yelp/detect-secrets' for detect-secrets, and 'https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks' for check-added-large-files. (3) Run 'pre-commit install' in the repository to install the git hooks. (4) Test the hooks by running 'pre-commit run --all-files' to see if they work on existing code. (5) Add 'pre-commit' to either requirements.txt or create requirements-dev.txt with it. (6) Stage and commit the .pre-commit-config.yaml file with a commit message mentioning pre-commit or hooks. The verification will check that: the config file exists with all four hooks, git hooks are installed, pre-commit is in requirements, and the config was committed.
